title: Sierra Adventures / Activities Reno Tahoe, LLC
specs: Activities cover earth, wind, water, and snow adventures

All participants must sign a release before engaging in activity
Team building events available for earth and water adventures

includes: Safety gear, maps, and accessories included in packages
Guides included in tours and adventures
gap: Duration not stated for most offerings
blurb: Guests can choose from activities such as ATV tours, mountain biking, rock climbing, horseback riding, rafting, kayaking, snowmobiling, ballooning, and more. Many adventures include lessons, clinics, and gear rentals. Deposits are required to book, and cancellations have specific refund policies.
extraNote: 50% activity deposit required to confirm booking · One-day adventures require $50 per person deposit; two-day require $100 per person deposit · Cancellations 15 days or more before trip get 100% refund; no refund less than 15 days · Date changes cost $25 per person · Cancellations after deadline subject to fees of 25% or full cost · Weather policies not stated · Downtown Reno at the Silver Legacy Adventure Desk for pool classes; other meeting points not specified. · Summer/Fall (June-November) and Winter/Spring (November-May)
